name: Safety First
summary: Razzeric sends you south with a seaforium booster, bound for Shreev in Gadgetzan. Its safety is still on, though Razzeric asked for it to be removed.

sections.title: A Safety Nobody Wanted
sections.body: Razzeric finds the safety still on his seaforium booster. It limits the power the booster can deliver, though he had asked Shreev to remove it. So he gives you the booster and sends you south of the Shimmering Flats, into the Tanaris desert. Shreev can remove the safety at the Gadgetzan Gizmorium.

sections.title: Shreev's Answer
sections.body: At the Gizmorium, Shreev denies putting a safety lock on the booster. He says it is almost entirely seaforium explosive, already altered to deliver more of its payload when used. Razzeric, Shreev says, is never content unless he goes all the way to eleven.

faq.answer: Razzeric, the goblin pilot, sends you to Gadgetzan with his seaforium booster.

faq.q: Why is Razzeric unhappy with the booster?
aliases: what is wrong with the booster
faq.answer: The safety Shreev left on the booster limits its power, though Razzeric asked for it to be removed.
Shreev is at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan, in the Tanaris desert south of the Shimmering Flats.

faq.q: What item are you carrying to Gadgetzan?
aliases: what do you bring to shreev
faq.answer: You carry Razzeric's seaforium booster, which he gives you to bring to Shreev.
A second part of the chain follows, also called Safety First.
